mainTitle.title: Sensors of medical and biological information

instruction.paragraph1: Before starting, turn on the setup by clicking the power button on the panel and switching its state from <Off> to <On>. After that, you can choose what you want to test (strain gauge, temperature sensor, or photoresistor).
instruction.paragraph2: To open the strain gauge window, select number 1 by clicking the gray rectangular handle in the <Sensor selection> section of the panel. Then you can work with it by choosing the required weight values.
instruction.paragraph3: To open the temperature sensor window, select number 2 by clicking the gray rectangular handle in the <Sensor selection> section of the panel. Then, below the panel, press <Start> and wait a few seconds — the temperature will begin to rise.
instruction.paragraph4: To open the photoresistor window, select number 4 by clicking the gray rectangular handle in the <Sensor selection> section of the panel. Then choose the circle area.
instruction.paragraph5: To reset all results and repeat the experiment, turn the setup off and on again.
